svg.aria-label: Spearman correlation of each series with the +5 bp pressure indicator, by lead
svg.text: Spearman correlation with the +5 bp pressure indicator, 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31
exploratory screen; ranked by the strongest absolute value over the leads; blank = not formed
red: a higher series goes with more pressure; blue: the reverse; full colour at |rho| = 0.5; values shown from 0.15
